name: Discworld MUD lib (v2)
english_description: The middle of three Cratylus Discworld FluffOS-bundle snapshots in this collection (bundled fluffos-2.9-ds2.05 driver ignored). Same official Discworld mudlib as libs/discworld (v3), converted independently from dw_fluffos_v2/lib/ and given the same mechanical FluffOS-compat fixes as v1. Port 40272.
